made.name: runs
made.sql:
CREATE TABLE runs (
      seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
      id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      -- What started it: a Message from the person, sent or tried again, or the clock, for a Brief
      -- or a Review.
      started_by TEXT NOT NULL,
      -- The id of the person's Message it answers, never its words; for the clock's, the id of the
      -- record that started it in the Conversation.
      message TEXT,
      -- The runtime's handle on the Message it answers, to learn how it ended after a restart.
      -- None for a Run never started, because the month's spend had reached the cap.
      submission INTEGER,
      at INTEGER NOT NULL,
      model TEXT NOT NULL,
      input_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      output_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      cache_read_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      cache_write_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      -- In US dollars, by the price table shipped with the code.
      cost REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      -- How it ended, null while it is going.
      ended TEXT,
      -- Why it failed, for a Run that did: the model not reached, or the key refused.
      failure TEXT,
      -- For a Run trying a failed one again, the runtime's first record that may be its own: the
      -- records before it are the Runs' before it, and their spend counted with them.
      from_record INTEGER,
      -- For a Run answering a new Message, the number of the change the log stood at when the
      -- Agent was told what changed since the last Message it answered: the next is told from there.
      told_through INTEGER,
      -- For a Brief or a Review once it has ended: whether it left a Message (a Brief with nothing
      -- to raise leaves none), whether a newer one of its kind replaced it unread, when Praxis first
      -- showed it, and the ids of the Tasks it names, as JSON.
      raised INTEGER,
      replaced INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      read_at INTEGER,
      tasks_named TEXT
    )

      -- made or its time was set: nothing at or before it is due.
      through INTEGER NOT NULL,
      -- The time it came that the Run going, or the last tried, is for.
      trying INTEGER,
      -- How many tries at it have failed, when the next may be made, and why the last failed.
      tries INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      retry_at INTEGER,
      failure TEXT,
      -- Since when its tries have failed, for the Notice, until one of its kind runs.
      failing_since INTEGER,
      -- The time it came for which a Run not started at the cap has been recorded.
      capped INTEGER
    )

made.name: words_index_entry_made
made.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER words_index_entry_made AFTER INSERT ON entries BEGIN
        INSERT INTO words_index (rowid, kind, record_id, text)
          VALUES (NEW.seq * 4 + 0, 'entry', NEW.id, NEW.words);
      END

        UPDATE words_index SET text = NEW.words WHERE rowid = NEW.seq * 4 + 0;
      END

made.name: words_index_person_removed
words_index_trashed
made.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER words_index_trashed AFTER INSERT ON trashed BEGIN
      DELETE FROM words_index WHERE rowid IN (SELECT index_row FROM (SELECT seq * 4 + 0 AS index_row, 'entry' AS kind, id, words AS text
         FROM entries WHERE NEW.kind = 'entry' AND id = NEW.record_id UNION ALL SELECT seq * 4 + 1 AS index_row, 'task' AS kind, id, title AS text
         FROM tasks WHERE NEW.kind = 'task' AND id = NEW.record_id UNION ALL SELECT seq * 4 + 2 AS index_row, 'project' AS kind, id, name AS text
         FROM projects WHERE NEW.kind = 'project' AND id = NEW.record_id UNION ALL SELECT seq * 4 + 3 AS index_row, 'person' AS kind, id, name AS text
         FROM persons WHERE NEW.kind = 'person' AND id = NEW.record_id));
    END

made.name: words_index_restored
made.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER words_index_restored AFTER DELETE ON trashed BEGIN
      INSERT INTO words_index (rowid, kind, record_id, text) SELECT seq * 4 + 0 AS index_row, 'entry' AS kind, id, words AS text
         FROM entries WHERE OLD.kind = 'entry' AND id = OLD.record_id UNION ALL SELECT seq * 4 + 1 AS index_row, 'task' AS kind, id, title AS text
         FROM tasks WHERE OLD.kind = 'task' AND id = OLD.record_id UNION ALL SELECT seq * 4 + 2 AS index_row, 'project' AS kind, id, name AS text
         FROM projects WHERE OLD.kind = 'project' AND id = OLD.record_id UNION ALL SELECT seq * 4 + 3 AS index_row, 'person' AS kind, id, name AS text
         FROM persons WHERE OLD.kind = 'person' AND id = OLD.record_id;
    END

made.name: ladder
made.sql:
CREATE TABLE ladder (
    one INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (one = 1),
    step INTEGER NOT NULL,
    stuck_under TEXT,
    stuck_step INTEGER,
    stuck_cause TEXT,
    bookmark TEXT,
    bookmark_step INTEGER
  )

made.name: contexts
made.sql:
CREATE TABLE contexts (
      seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
      id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      name TEXT NOT NULL,
      accent TEXT NOT NULL,
      -- A retired Context is hidden and keeps everything.
      retired INTEGER NOT NULL,
      -- When the last Backup holding its file was made, null while none has: the one Backup kept
      -- past its 30 days while the Context is stuck on an upgrade (section 11).
      backed_up INTEGER
    )

made.name: connections
made.sql:
CREATE TABLE connections (
      seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
      id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      name TEXT NOT NULL,
      context_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES contexts (id),
      reading_only INTEGER NOT NULL,
      ended INTEGER NOT NULL
    )

made.name: devices
made.sql:
CREATE TABLE devices (
      seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
      id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      name TEXT NOT NULL,
      notifications INTEGER NOT NULL,
      subscription TEXT,
      -- When it last called a Deployment tool: a sighting, which no write reports as an Effect.
      seen INTEGER NOT NULL
    )

made.name: spend_cap
made.sql:
CREATE TABLE spend_cap (
      one INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (one = 1),
      dollars REAL NOT NULL
    )

made.name: spend
made.sql:

      month TEXT NOT NULL,
      context_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      dollars REAL NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY (month, context_id)
    )

made.name: key_refused

CREATE TABLE key_refused (

    )

made.name: backups

      counted_from INTEGER NOT NULL,

    )

made.name: stuck_contexts

    )

    )
